news.title: Bitmine reports $6.3 billion net loss in latest fiscal year, driven by 44% ether decline
news.summary: According to its SEC filing, nearly $6.23 billion of the net losses came from unrealized fair value losses on digital asset holdings.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
news.summary: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.

news.title: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain
news.summary: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.

news.title: Tron Inc reports 22% rise in Q3 net income as unrealized staking revenue grows
news.summary: The company reported Q3 2026 net income of $14.9 million, up 22% year-over-year, with a nine-month net income of $39.4 million, up 203%.

news.title: Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip
news.summary: The Minnesota lawmaker, who helped establish the Congressional Crypto Caucus, will stay on as Republican whip after Democrats won the midterms.

news.title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
news.summary: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.

news.title: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
news.summary: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.

news.title: Global banks commit $270M to stablecoin venture targeting 2027 launch
news.summary: Project Faro, backed by Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and BBVA, has secured $270 million in funding to launch a US dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027.

news.title: Forward Industries grows SOL treasury to 8.7 million as token hits nearly three-month low
news.summary: Forward adds a $50 million credit line and housing-linked investment to support further SOL accumulation.

news.title: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
news.summary: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.

news.title: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
news.summary: The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform.

news.title: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
news.summary: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.

news.title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
news.summary: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

news.title: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
news.summary: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.

news.title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
news.summary: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

news.title: Bitcoin slides below $74,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI as analysts warn of drop to $70k
news.summary: BTC slipped under $74,000 after October CPI beat forecasts. Analysts flag $73,000 support and a possible drop toward $69,000.

news.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
news.summary: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

news.title: Grayscale pledges $1 million alongside Zcash ad blitz as token and ETF fall 12%
news.summary: Grayscale’s Zcash push comes as its ETF faces continued withdrawals, extending October’s net outflows.

news.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
news.summary: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

news.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
news.summary: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.

news.title: TON Strategy earns $13.1 million from GRAM staking in Q3 as Telegram rolls out native wallet
news.summary: TON Strategy reported $13.1M in Q3 revenue, mostly from GRAM staking, and a $24M net loss as Telegram rolled out its native Gram Wallet.

news.title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
news.summary: Twice now, crypto firms have found themselves on the side of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission in holding that perpetual futures aren't swaps.

news.title: Polymarket US trading volume jumps 266% despite regulatory battles
news.summary: Trading volume on Polymarket’s US exchange surged from June to October, fueled by sports betting, even as the platform faces mounting regulatory scrutiny.

news.title: Bitcoin nears 11-week low after ‘discouraging’ US CPI inflation beat
news.summary: Bitcoin and US stocks initially fall after October inflation tops forecasts, with traders expecting a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.

news.title: Alta raises $47.5 million Series A to build a blockchain for financial institutions
news.summary: Alta’s blockchain will combine privacy and compliance controls for banks and other financial firms.

news.title: Canaan’s Q3 revenue plunges 90% to $14.5 million as bitcoin mining hardware sales slump
news.summary: Canaan's Q3 revenue fell 90% to $14.5 million, though cryptocurrency and derivatives gains supported an $8 million profit.

news.title: MEGA commits $30 million to new products, starting with AI inference
news.summary: The MegaETH Foundation has rebranded as MEGA and committed $30 million to new products, starting with AI inference.

news.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
news.summary: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

news.title: Moody’s and Chainlink test cross-chain credit ratings distribution
news.summary: Moody's Ratings and Chainlink ran a testnet pilot using CCIP to distribute credit ratings data across permissioned and public blockchains.

news.title: Bitdeer reports record Q3 revenue as net loss widens to $125.5 million
news.summary: Bitdeer reported record third-quarter revenue of $320.7 million as bitcoin production surged 248% to 3,855 BTC.

news.title: Will stablecoins survive once the banks catch up?
news.summary: As crypto firms and banks converge, it is fair to ask what lasting advantage stablecoins have, argues Alessandro Hatami, founder of Pacemakers and former COO of Digital Banking at Lloyds Banking Group.

news.title: Visa adds Monad to stablecoin settlement network options
news.summary: Visa has added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, the Monad Foundation said.

news.title: eToro’s Q3 profit plunges 74% as weaker crypto trading weighs on earnings
news.summary: eToro reported a 74% decline in Q3 profit to $15 million, with weaker crypto activity weighing on earnings.

news.title: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes
news.summary: The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list.

news.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
news.summary: A December rate hike appears completely assured, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

news.title: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
news.summary: Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027.

news.title: Bitcoin may benefit as global tightening slows, Binance Research says
news.summary: Binance Research says Bitcoin could find support as global monetary tightening slows, even as markets price in a December Fed rate hike.

news.title: Ripple Prime head Marc Asch to step down, Noel Kimmel named successor
news.summary: Asch is stepping down as head of the institutional prime brokerage.

news.title: Bitcoin breaks with stocks, declines as ETF outflows mount, MARA reduces holdings
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 10, 2026

news.title: HIVE reports $79 million quarterly net loss as bitcoin mining revenue falls and AI business grows
news.summary: HIVE reported a $78.7 million quarterly net loss and $84.9 million in revenue, including $8.8 million from its AI business.

news.title: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures
news.summary: Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies backed the CFTC in a lawsuit over whether US exchanges can list perpetual futures tied to individual stocks.

news.title: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys
news.summary: The exchange urged iPhone users to remove apps installed from untrusted sources, and it is unclear whether Apple’s latest iOS updates fix the flaw.

news.title: Bitcoin lags stock rebound in advance of U.S. inflation report
news.summary: Bitcoin slipped despite a Monday rebound in U.S. stocks, with spot ETFs losing $201 million as traders await October inflation data later today.

news.title: Ex-employee sues Ethereum Foundation and Vitalik Buterin over firing
news.summary: Kayleen Fulton alleges she was fired less than two weeks after disclosing a cancer diagnosis and helping organize a staff letter challenging a requirement to endorse the foundation’s new mandate.

news.title: Exodus shares rise 10% ahead of Q3 earnings showing 7% revenue growth, $8.3 million loss
news.summary: Exodus shares rose 10% as the company reported third-quarter revenue of $32.5 million and a net loss of $8.3 million.

news.title: Bitcoin slips before U.S. inflation report as traders price in Fed rate increase
news.summary: Fed Governor Waller backs December tightening even if inflation cools, while falling oil prices offer some relief and Anthropic withdraws IPO pricing details.

news.title: Live news: Bitcoin falls to nearly three-month low after disappointing inflation data
news.summary: A rate hike in December appears totally assured now, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

news.title: Ark Invest trims Block, Bullish and its own bitcoin ETF holdings while buying Nvidia, SoFi
news.summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest sold $6.1 million worth of Block shares and $1.13 million worth of Bullish shares through its ETFs on Monday.

news.title: NEAR AI says SGLang vulnerability exposed user account details in security breach
news.summary: NEAR AI explained that it found no indication that stored Private Chat conversations or uploaded files were accessed.

news.title: Bitcoin price eyes $74K as Fed rate-hike bets hit 96% after Waller speech
news.summary: Bitcoin price action and stock futures trended lower after Fed governor Christopher Waller said that he would vote to raise interest rates by 0.25% at the December FOMC meeting.

news.title: The crypto wallet that grew up inside Telegram is striking out on its own
news.summary: The app will offer crypto trading, tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs, and perpetual futures, all already available through Telegram.

news.title: Walt launches standalone crypto trading app following Wallet in Telegram rebrand
news.summary: Walt launched a standalone app, expanding its crypto investment platform beyond Telegram for the first time.

news.title: Coinbase, Kalshi, Kraken parent back CFTC in legal fight over stock perpetual futures
news.summary: The Capital Markets Alliance argues that the products fall under the Securities and Exchange Commission’s jurisdiction.

news.title: BitGo Q3 profit nearly doubles on crypto gains as revenue falls 51%
news.summary: BitGo’s $71 million unrealized gain on its crypto holdings helped nearly double its net income, but revenue and earnings came in below preliminary analyst expectations.

news.title: BitGo revenue falls 51% in Q3 as trading slows; net income rises on treasury gains
news.summary: The revenue decline was driven by continued soft crypto trading environment and a higher mix of lower-margin stablecoin transactions.

news.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $1.66B over seven trading sessions
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $201 million Monday, with seven straight sessions of net withdrawals from BlackRock’s IBIT totaling $1.66 billion.

news.title: Securitize agrees to buy River One to expand into asset-backed lending
news.summary: Securitize agreed to buy River One to bring stablecoin funding to asset-backed lending and expects the deal to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.

news.title: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes
news.summary: Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.

news.title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion in six weeks, plans to sell more
news.summary: MARA paid off every loan backed by its bitcoin and says the rest of its coins can fund AI datacenters.

news.title: XRP Ledger maps out quantum-proof accounts, with no extra fees for users
news.summary: The XRP Ledger Foundation’s design lets owners add a quantum-resistant key and switch off the old one, part of a roadmap that puts the network on track for a full transition by 2028.

news.title: Bitcoin faces U.S. CPI test as analysts warn inflation relief may not be enough
news.summary: Bitcoin trades below $75,000 ahead of the October inflation data. Analysts warning that sustainable recovery depends on improving liquidity and spot ETF demand rather than temporary macro relief.

news.title: Securitize pushes into $6 trillion asset-backed finance market with River One acquisition
news.summary: The tokenization firm unveiled an acquisition and a $50 million stock buyback as quarterly revenue rose 13%. SECZ shares jumped 10% after hours.

news.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
news.summary: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

news.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
news.summary: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

news.title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
news.summary: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

news.title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
news.summary: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder 117,000 NEAR, worth about $430,000, from the $6.3 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says.

news.title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks amid Wall Street's blockchain race
news.summary: Avalanche will serve as the core settlement ledger for the exchange's planned blockchain stock market

news.title: Solana set for its first tokenized stock venue under SEC framework, listing Galaxy
news.summary: Formation Securities plans to launch in early 2027 with Galaxy, Exodus and Forward Industries shares, expanding the U.S. regulator's experiment in blockchain-based stock trading.
